title: The batched object reader accepts SHA-256 object ids
description: The batched object reader accepts SHA-256 object ids
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-git-utils-010 requires committed blob and tree reads at a fixed commit to be served by one cat-file --batch child; in a SHA-256 repository a read at a full 64-character commit id fell back to its own git show (#985)
acceptance_criteria: in a repository initialized with --object-format=sha256, show and ls-tree reads at a full 64-character commit id are answered by the one cat-file --batch child, byte for byte equal to per-file reads, and a missing path still reads as absent
